scope: Gridfinity shelf generator and all nine board-system presets

finding.issue: Gussets could obstruct local screw-head/Allen-key access on bolted systems
finding.fix: Extend each head recess forward by 10 mm through crossing gussets
finding.regression: Every bolted mount checks the 10 mm screw-head approach volume, fastener intrusion and remaining bearing material
finding.limit: Local pocket for a short L-shaped Allen key; not a full-length driver channel or a physical assembly test
